summary: Retest of the iteration_7 fixes. Backend: test_phase4_screens.py has 18 passed, 2 skipped (free-plan caps, billing off) and 1 failed. The failure is the new /auth/me rate-limit regression test. Fixes 2, 3 and 4 pass in the UI. Fix 1 FAILS. After 12 quick reloads, /auth/me returns 429 from the 8th call. All 5 client retries (2.5s apart) also get 429, so the header shows 'Sign in'. Clicking follow-team then sends the user to /sign-in?next=/team/... Regression is fine: Insights (13 cards), Track record (tr-not-ready), Search 'sev' gives Sevilla, the match Share card downloads Venezia-v-Inter.png (valid PNG, 1200x630), and no page overflows at 390px (insights, finder, search, following, track-record, match).

critical.issue: Still counted in the 'auth' group, which allows 10 requests per minute per IP in a fixed 60s window. Rejected calls also add to the count. A few reloads give 429 for the rest of the minute.

minor.issue: Accepts stat=goals (a player-only stat) and returns an empty list instead of 400 or a fallback.

ui_bugs.issue: The retry budget (5 x 2.5s = 12.5s) is shorter than the 60s rate-limit window, and Retry-After is ignored. On a cold load the user ends up as user:null, the header shows Sign in, and Follow/Save send them to sign-in.

Pick Players + Goals, then switch to Teams. The select shows 'Shots' but the URL and the query keep stat=goals, so Search returns nothing. The stat should reset to a valid TEAM_STATS value when scope changes.

issues: The subtitle always reads '{team} v {opp}'. For an away team it says 'Inter v Venezia' while the fixture row and the match page say 'Venezia v Inter'. Use home v away order, or write '@ opp' / 'vs'.
In every new browser context it covers the bottom-right content on desktop and about a quarter of the screen on mobile. This is expected until dismissed, but it is large on 390px.

action_items: Fix 1 is not fixed. In security_mw.py, put GET /api/auth/me in the 'read' group, e.g. grp = 'auth' if path.startswith('/api/auth/') and path != '/api/auth/me' else ...; or give it its own higher limit. Optionally also make refresh() wait for Retry-After seconds on 429 instead of a fixed 2.5s x5.
Finder: when scope changes, reset stat to 'shots' if the current stat is not in the new options list.
ForecastCard: show the fixture in home v away order (or mark the venue) so it matches the match page.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.js: reading state via setMe((m)=>{kept=m;return m;}) depends on React running the updater eagerly. Use a useRef that mirrors `me` instead.
Actions.jsx: the module-level saved-keys cache is cleared on toggle, but other mounted stars keep their old state until they remount. This is acceptable.
FollowButton makes one GET /me/follows per button. Cache it like savedKeys.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (4 of 5 review items pass; Fix 1 fails)

seed_data_creation: None. The test user's follows (Sevilla, Inter) and saved forecasts were deleted from the DB after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: Fix 2 (saved list and feed cards show 'Inter' with crest; follow Inter 64eaa41c-2da7-46b5-b679-b15be0525ccc to get feed forecasts, Sevilla has none). Fix 3 (mode, venue and Reset clear rows; no 'undefined'; team stats are Shots/SOT/Corners/Tackles; team corners form gives 18 rows). Fix 4 (star aria-pressed=true after reload and in the Saved list; pressing it removes and shows a toast). Following tabs use data-testid following-tabs-{feed|follows|saved}. Anonymous Finder search hits a daily cap, then returns 401 SIGN_IN_REQUIRED and redirects to sign-in (expected). To retest Fix 1: sign in, then do 12 page.reload() calls; header-account must still be visible.
